exercises.instructionEn: Sandra and David are in Cameroon, West Africa, to write about a python hunter.
exercises.instructionUz: Sandra va David G'arbiy Afrikadagi Kamerunda piton ovchisi haqida yozish uchun kelishgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
YANGI HIKOYa - 'PITON OVI'.

  ⚠ Sandra va David - 'The Shark
  Caller' hikoyasidagi muxbirlar
  (24-25, 46-47-betlar). Endi
  Kamerunda.


⚠ 'DO NOT DISTURB':

  = bezovta qilmang.
  ⚠ Mehmonxona eshigidagi yozuv.
  ⚠ Bu yerda: pitonni bezovta
  qilmang!


⚠ 'A PYTHON':

  = piton (katta ilon).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈpaɪθən/.
  ⚠ Zaharsiz, lekin bo'g'ib
  o'ldiradi.


⚠ 'A HUNT' / 'TO HUNT':

  = ov / ovlamoq.
  ⚠ 'a hunter' = ovchi.


⚠ 'CAMEROON':

  = Kamerun (G'arbiy Afrika).
  Poytaxti - Yaoundé.


⚠ QISM QISQAChA:

  Abou va otasi Adamou - piton
  ovchilari. Adamou pitonni
  teshikdan tortib chiqarmoqchi.
  David suratga olish uchun teshikka
  kiradi - va 'HELP!!' deb
  qichqiradi. Davomi 69-70-betlarda.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA HIKOYaDA:

  present perfect continuous: "He's
     been hunting pythons for thirty
     years"
  'enough': 'strong ENOUGH to kill
     you' (10-unit mavzusi)
  buyruq mayli: 'Be careful!',
     "Don't get too close!" (10-unit
     mavzusi)
  'too': 'TOO close' (10-unit)

tasks.en: Sandra and David are in Cameroon, West Africa, to write about a python hunter.
tasks.uz: Sandra va David G'arbiy Afrikadagi Kamerunda piton ovchisi haqida yozish uchun kelishgan.

tasks.en: [2] David: Hello! I'm David and this is Sandra. Are you the python hunters? — Abou: Yes - I'm Abou, and this is my father, Adamou. He's been hunting pythons for thirty years.
tasks.uz: [2] David: Salom! Men Davidman, bu Sandra. Siz piton ovchilarimisiz? — Abou: Ha - men Abouman, bu esa otam Adamou. U o'ttiz yildan beri piton ovlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "He's been hunting" - present perfect
continuous + 'for thirty years'.
⚠ 'this is' - tanishtirish.

tasks.en: [3] Sandra: Aren't pythons dangerous, Abou? Why do you hunt them? — Abou: Well, they aren't poisonous, but they are big, and strong enough to kill you! We hunt them for their meat and their beautiful skins.
tasks.uz: [3] Sandra: Pitonlar xavfli emasmi, Abou? Nega ularni ovlaysizlar? — Abou: Ular zaharli emas, lekin katta va sizni o'ldirishga yetarli darajada kuchli! Biz ularni go'shti va chiroyli terisi uchun ovlaymiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ "Aren't pythons dangerous?" - inkor savol =
'xavfli-ku, to'g'rimi?'
⚠ 'poisonous' = zaharli.
⚠ 'strong ENOUGH to' = ... ga yetarli kuchli.

tasks.en: [4] Abou: Can you see these marks on the ground? They show there's a python inside the hole. My father is going to go down and pull it out.
tasks.uz: [4] Abou: Yerdagi bu izlarni ko'ryapsizmi? Ular teshik ichida piton borligini ko'rsatadi. Otam pastga tushib uni tortib chiqaradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a mark' = iz, belgi.
⚠ 'to pull out' = tortib chiqarmoq.
⚠ 'is going to' - niyat.

tasks.en: [5] Sandra: What's your father doing, Abou? — Abou: He's covering his arm with animal skin, like a glove. Pythons have got long, sharp teeth, and they bite!
tasks.uz: [5] Sandra: Otang nima qilyapti, Abou? — Abou: U qo'lini hayvon terisi bilan qo'lqopdek o'rayapti. Pitonlarning uzun, o'tkir tishlari bor va ular tishlaydi!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to cover with' = ... bilan qoplamoq.
⚠ 'a glove' = qo'lqop.
⚠ 'sharp' = o'tkir; 'to bite' = tishlamoq.

tasks.en: [6] David: I want to take pictures of the snake inside its hole, before Adamou catches it. — Abou: Be careful, David! Don't get too close to the python!
tasks.uz: [6] David: Adamou uni tutishidan oldin ilonni teshik ichida suratga olmoqchiman. — Abou: Ehtiyot bo'l, David! Pitonga juda yaqin borma!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'before Adamou CATCHES' - present simple.
⚠ 'Be careful!' / "Don't get too close!" -
BUYRUQ MAYLI (10-unit).
⚠ 'too close' = juda yaqin.

tasks.en: [7] David: HELP!! — Abou: Quick, Sandra! Help me pull him out!
tasks.uz: [7] David: YORDAM!! — Abou: Tez, Sandra! Uni tortib chiqarishga yordam ber!

ANTONIMLAR:

  strong ≠ WEAK (kuchli ≠ kuchsiz)

⚠ 'HARMLESS':

  ⚠ 'harmful' = zararli.


⚠ 'BLUNT':

  = o'tmas (pichoq).
  ⚠ 'a blunt knife'.

exercises.explanationUz:
TOO va ENOUGH.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TOO = JUDA (ortiqcha, SALBIY)   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIFATDAN OLDIN:
  'too close', 'too cold', 'too
   heavy'

  "Don't get TOO CLOSE to the
   python."
  ⚠ Ma'no: kerakligidan ORTIQ →
  muammo.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENOUGH = YETARLI (IJOBIY)       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIFATDAN KEYIN:
  'strong enough', 'old enough',
  'tall enough'

  'Pythons are STRONG ENOUGH to kill
   you.'
  ⚠ Ma'no: kerakli darajada.


⚠ ENG MUHIM - O'RNI:

  TOO + sifat    (too cold)
  sifat + ENOUGH (cold enough)

  ⚠ 'enough cold' - XATO!
  ⚠ Lekin OTDAN OLDIN: 'enough
  money', 'enough time'.


⚠ 'TOO ... TO' va 'ENOUGH ... TO':

  "It's TOO cold TO play." = juda
     sovuq, o'ynab bo'lmaydi
  "It's warm ENOUGH TO play." =
     o'ynash uchun yetarli iliq


⚠ 'FOR ME':

  'too heavy FOR ME to carry' = men
  ko'tarish uchun juda og'ir.


⚠ 'TOO' va 'VERY':

  very = juda (neytral)
  too = juda (ortiqcha, salbiy)
  'It's VERY hot.' - shunchaki issiq
  'It's TOO hot.' - chidab bo'lmaydi

tasks.en: We use too before adjectives or adverbs. It has a negative meaning. Don't get too close to the python.
tasks.uz: 'too' ni sifat yoki ravishdan OLDIN ishlatamiz. Salbiy ma'noga ega. Pitonga juda yaqin borma.

tasks.en: We use enough after adjectives or adverbs. It has a positive meaning. Pythons are strong enough to kill you.
tasks.uz: 'enough' ni sifat yoki ravishdan KEYIN ishlatamiz. Ijobiy ma'noga ega. Pitonlar sizni o'ldirishga yetarli kuchli.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'RNIGA QARANG:

  bo'sh joy SIFATDAN OLDIN → too
  bo'sh joy SIFATDAN KEYIN → enough


JAVOBLAR:

  1 It's TOO cold to play in the
    garden.
  2 He isn't old ENOUGH to drive a
    car.
  3 She is tall ENOUGH to reach the
    top shelf.
  4 It's TOO dark in here for me to
    read.
  5 These bags are TOO heavy for me
    to carry.


⚠ 2-BAND - INKOR:

  "isn't old ENOUGH" = yetarli katta
  emas (haydash uchun).


⚠ 'THE TOP SHELF':

  = eng yuqori javon.
  ⚠ 'to reach' = yetmoq (qo'l).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words, then say how we use these pronouns and adjectives.
exercises.instructionUz: Tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng bu olmosh va sifatlarni qanday ishlatishimizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLMOShLAR JADVALI - TO'LIQ:

  SUBJECT (ega):
    I, you, he, she, it, we, you,
    they
  OBJECT (to'ldiruvchi):
    me, you, him, HER, it, us, you,
    THEM
  POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVES (egalik
  sifati - OT bilan):
    my, YOUR, his, her, ITS, our,
    your, their
  POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS (egalik
  olmoshi - OTSIZ):
    mine, yours, HIS, hers, -, ours,
    yours, THEIRS


⚠ QANDAY IShLATILADI:

  EGA - fe'ldan OLDIN:
    'HE wanted to take pictures.'
  TO'LDIRUVChI - fe'l/predlogdan
  KEYIN:
    'Help ME pull HER out.'
  EGALIK SIFATI - OTDAN OLDIN:
    'HIS arm', 'OUR house'
  EGALIK OLMOShI - OT O'RNIDA:
    'This book is MINE.' (my book)


⚠ 'ITS' va "IT'S":

  its = uning (egalik) - APOSTROFSIZ
  it's = it is / it has
  ⚠ ENG KO'P XATO!


⚠ 'HIS' - IKKI VAZIFADA:

  'his arm' (sifat) va 'This is
  his.' (olmosh) - BIR XIL shakl.


⚠ 'ITS' NING EGALIK OLMOShI YO'Q:

  Jadvalda '-' turibdi.

     you)

     his, our)


⚠ 'THE SUBURBS':
